about: SCION-04 · Frank Mouris image torrent: every asset, its source and rights, and the operation that made it.

assets.what: 50 archive frames (dog) with SAM masks, cut into tiles
assets.operation: each frame cropped twice (whole frame; and the SAM-mask bounding box widened to 4:3), resized to 64x48/32x24/16x12/8x6 tiles; placed by a quadtree into computed moulds; tile mean shifted to the mould's guide colour (contrast kept); held tiles play their own shot forward at 12 fps

assets.what: the shapes of the dog, person, door, porch, moon and the words
assets.operation: computed (drawn as polygons from the PAELEO score: dog act values, person posture/reach/low hand, door state); never shown directly, only filled with archive tiles

assets.what: the dog decision trace
assets.operation: read only: drives every mould and every rate

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display (COME HERE, title), Literata italic (it's all right, come in), JetBrains Mono (made-of card)
assets.operation: text rendered into moulds, then filled with archive tiles (spoken words); plain text on the cards

assets.what: all sound
assets.operation: synthesized with numpy: one click per replaced tile (from cache/stats.json), formant voice, stick-slip door creak, paw thumps from the score walk phase, breath noise, a sine chord, 24 Hz projector purr, crickets

assets.what: the warm glow of the doorway into the dusk
assets.operation: computed screen-blend radial grade (not a picture); the light itself is lantern, bulb and star tiles

assets.what: not used
assets.operation: none
